testcase.name: ids are unique and immutable and the target must exist()
the operation vocabulary keeps the legacy set and adds the typed V2 set next to it()
section and site operations are unchanged and mix with V2 operations in one request()
at most 50 operations per request still applies()
adding then removing on a legacy document returns exactly the legacy document()
a failing operation names its index and the input document is never changed()
an operation cannot smuggle SQL a URL a credential or code()
update merges the given fields and null clears a field()
an operation that leaves a dangling reference is rejected by the validator with the path()
every typed collection can be added updated and removed and the result stays valid()
theme and the publish draft are updated through operations too()
